description: A D1 database for the Worker: Drizzle schema, SQL migrations applied before each deploy, and tests against a real local D1.

scripts.deploy: pnpm build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

boundaries: A schema change is a new SQL migration (`pnpm db:generate`). Never edit one that has been applied.
Work that must be all-or-nothing goes in one `db.batch()`: D1 has no interactive transactions.

manual: Create the database with `pnpm wrangler d1 create __SLUG__` and paste its id into `wrangler.jsonc` (`database_id`).
